title: Marlene's News
notes: Outline, stage 3, side quest: "The news board mentions you, for better or worse: seen at [Tuck's] at 11, or seen at the pantry Thursday. Private choices showing up in public is the Integrity rule at work." Claude's draft. The board items are in news.json.

tag.item: Integrity: private choices show up in public

board.speaker: [Marlene]

effects.title: Marlene's News
effects.objective: You made the board. Read it at the register.

text: [Marlene] taps the board by the register with the coffee pot. "You made the news."
"Don't look at me. I just pin up what people tell me."
One card, in [Gus]'s handwriting, is about you at [Tuck's] at 11 on a weeknight.
One card is a thank-you with your name on it. You didn't think anybody saw.

choices.label: Read the board.
result: Small town. Everyone sees everyone. The board just writes it down.
